description: Aider-polyglot style (JavaScript): implement full text justification from a stub and an instructions file - greedy packing, left-first distribution of the spare spaces, unpadded last and single-word lines, and a twist on the classic exercise: words longer than the width are split with a hyphen at width - 1 after the current line is closed, with the remainder rejoining the following words. The node:test suite is the acceptance bar and the post-turn verifier gives a repair round with the test output, like aider's second try.
